If your business cannot survive without paying Americans a fair wage, then that is nothing more than a personal problem.

Miami restaurant owner Wilkinson Sejour told CBS that his business has been suffering after several of his Haitian employees have been affected by Trump’s end of temporary protected status benefits for over 300,000 Haitians. He believes that because some of these people have called this country home for 10, 20, and sometimes even 30 years, that means they somehow should be afforded the right to be here. The problem with this is that is not how the law works.
